request.description: Small pixel-art particle effect for a side-view horse race game, seen from the side: a burst of wet mud clods kicked up backwards by a galloping hoof. 5 to 8 chunky lumps of dark wet mud of different sizes (2 to 6 px) fly up and backwards to the LEFT in an arc, tumble, then fall to the ground; a few tiny splatter droplets. Dark brown mud, glossy highlight pixel on each clod, 1 px darker outline. No smoke, no glow. 8 frames, canvas about 48x32 px, not looping, transparent background, crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliasing.
request.name: race-fx-mud

last_response.name: race-fx-mud
last_response.message: Made an 8-frame, 48×32 transparent hoof-kick burst: seven tumbling mud clods arc left and land, with dark outlines, glossy highlight pixels, and tiny splatters. Crisp pixels throughout—no smoke or glow.
